## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Istanbul, Turkey. It starts at No:67 Abdülezelpaşa Caddesi/ Fatih.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the Balat Toy Museum along Istanbul’s Golden Horn coast, which opened in 2021. Covering 1000 square meters, it features over 17,000 toys in 15 categories.
>
> Visit the museum shop and café afterward to pick up souvenirs and enjoy coffee and snacks.
>
> Enjoy the engaging exhibits and unique collections at the Balat Toy Museum.
